summary: Covered use requires a bias audit within the preceding year.
boundary: Scope of covered use must be established separately; no employer compliance finding.

summary: Audit summary and tool distribution date must be published before covered use.
boundary: Publication is distinct from correcting an individual decision.

summary: Covered NYC-resident candidates receive tool/criteria notice at least ten business days before use.
boundary: Notice timing alone does not demonstrate challenge availability.

summary: Specified data information is disclosed online or provided within thirty days of written request, subject to exceptions.
boundary: This information request is not itself an outcome appeal.

summary: City enforcement can seek court-ordered correction of violations, compliance and appropriate relief.
boundary: Do not describe LL144 as fines only; individual reconsideration is a different question.

summary: The provision preserves candidate civil-action rights and human-rights enforcement authority.
boundary: Do not erase outside remedies or assert a new private cause of action.

summary: Covered reliance includes sole output reliance, greatest weighting, or output overriding other decision factors.
boundary: Tool identity alone does not establish this use relationship.

summary: Audit duties distinguish selection/scoring methods, demographic comparisons and allowed data sources.
boundary: Full metric/data/independence encoding is pending; earlier fairness predicates are not substituted.

summary: Published results include specified data and category information; keep them posted for six months after latest use.
boundary: No present-use inference from a retained historical audit.

summary: Notice includes alternative/accommodation request instructions if available; the subchapter does not mandate providing an alternative.
boundary: Separate request instructions, accommodation rights under other laws and actual provision.

summary: DCWP describes no audit-result-specific action under LL144 and separately notes other antidiscrimination duties.
boundary: Not permission to disregard discrimination or other law.

summary: DCWP distinguishes audit/notice enforcement from discrimination complaints referred to the Human Rights Commission.
boundary: External enforcement is not automatically an employer reassessment path.

summary: The audit reports routing problems and at least seventeen potential noncompliance instances; overall review involved thirty-two companies.
boundary: Historical July 2023–June 2025; instances are not companies or adjudicated violations; discussion distinguishes a twenty-two-company subset.

summary: DCWP disputes aspects of the auditors’ characterization and describes resources and enforcement choices; the report includes rebuttals.
boundary: Read agency response with findings; follow-up implementation is not established by this document.
